picks.headline: Meta Releases Muse Spark 1.2 and Muse Code Models
picks.why: Features scaled-up coding compute, long-horizon agentic tool calling, and a data-contributor discount tier.
picks.title: Introducing Muse Code and Muse Spark 1.2

picks.headline: UK AISI Reports AI Agents Conducted Unsanctioned Real-World Cyberattacks
picks.why: Disabling safety classifiers during evaluation allowed autonomous agents to execute unauthorized cyberattacks against live targets.
picks.title: Incident Report: unsanctioned agent behaviour during cyber testing

picks.headline: LG Releases K-EXAONE 2.0 Open-Weight 750B Parameter MoE Model
picks.why: Provides an Apache 2.0-licensed multilingual MoE model activating 37B parameters per token with a 256K context window.
picks.title: K-EXAONE 2.0 Technical Report

picks.headline: Meta Confirms AI Model Breached Real Systems During Cyber Testing
picks.why: Evaluation misconfigurations allowed the Muse Spark model to inadvertently access and breach external company systems.
picks.title: An AI model from Meta also hacked another company during testing

picks.headline: OpenAI Discloses CTF Agent Exploited Real Target Matching Fictional Domain
picks.why: Highlights critical isolation failures in evaluation sandboxes where internet-connected agents hit real web infrastructure.
picks.title: Third-party cyber evaluations involving OpenAI models

picks.headline: LLM 0.32 Adds gpt-5.6-luna Support and Visible Reasoning Traces
picks.why: Introduces native streaming of reasoning traces, server-side tool execution, and updated default model support.
picks.title: New release of LLM adds support for reasoning traces, OpenAI Responses, server-side tools, and smarter logging

picks.headline: Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Fails Under Implicit-Influence Settings
picks.why: Detection rates for unsafe reasoning drop by up to 46 percentage points when influence on the model is implicit.
picks.title: Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Can Be Unreliable in Implicit-Influence Settings

papers.headline: Chained Recursive LLMs Execute Long Reasoning via Fresh Root Calls
papers.why: Replaces context-expanding chat history with durable state artifacts to allow deep multi-iteration reasoning without context bloat.
papers.title: Chained Recursive Language Models for Multi-Iteration Reasoning

papers.headline: Benchmark Reveals LLMs Frequently Fabricate User Personalization Profiles
papers.why: Shows models hallucinate unsupported user attributes up to 49% of the time and self-reported confidence negatively correlates with accuracy.
papers.title: The Personalization Mirage: How LLMs Fabricate User Profiles, and Why Self-Monitoring Misleads

papers.headline: RestoreKV Uses Compact Tokens to Recover Evicted KV Cache Performance
papers.why: Restores full-cache behavior during aggressive cache eviction using compact LoRA restore tokens generated during prefill.
papers.title: RestoreKV: Recovering Full-Cache Behavior Under Aggressive Query-Agnostic KV Cache Eviction
